title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO DR SHANKER DAYAL SHARMA ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to Dr Shanker Dayal Sharma, former President of India on his birth anniversary at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (August 19, 2026).
***
MJPS/SS/PKK

enrichment.summary: President Droupadi Murmu paid floral tributes to former President Dr Shanker Dayal Sharma at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his birth anniversary, observed on 19 August 2026.
enrichment.context: Dr Shanker Dayal Sharma served as the ninth President of India from 1992 to 1997, having earlier held positions as Vice-President of India, Governor of several states, and a Union Cabinet Minister. This release is a routine ceremonial tribute paid annually by the incumbent President to commemorate the birth anniversaries of former Presidents, and carries no policy content.

related_articles.title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO SHRI V.V. GIRI ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
related_articles.relationship: Both are recurring President's Secretariat releases of the same type: floral tributes paid by President Murmu to a former President of India on their birth anniversary.
